parameters.G: area * exp(center + query_hedonic @ saved_v2_beta), then clip to [0.65,1.5] * Bfuture
parameters.geometry_semantics: road representative or planar intersection; extent is support, not house error bound
parameters.location_compression: same group, exact location, project: keep every row residual and source row position
parameters.project_order: minimum actual fit-position distance, then project key lexicographically
parameters.project_vote: median of all eligible actual fit rows of this project inside query radius
parameters.query_cache: same group, exact query location, query project; no query fitted state
parameters.spatial_MAD: unweighted median absolute deviation of project medians from center
parameters.spatial_center: unweighted median of at most 40 project medians
